1.explanation:
• docs/ojs/test-ojs-echo-false-codetools-dropdown*.qmd show how code-tools dropdowns are rendered (and toggled) in the OJS format, which uses the same underlying code-tools extension logic.  
• docs/test-singleformat-html.qmd tests HTML single‐format front‐matter behavior and ensures that the HTML format honors code-tools settings.  
• docs/test-singleformat-context.qmd validates how front-matter options (like code-tools.source) are passed into the HTML rendering context.  
• docs/minimal.qmd gives the simplest QMD scaffold for reproducing front-matter–driven behaviors.  
• docs/test.qmd is the canonical smoke test for QMD code chunks and front-matter options and can be used to check for regressions when varying the code-tools.source setting.
1.bug_scenario: In this bug the HTML‐format “code‐tools” toolbar works correctly when you set `source: true` in the YAML front matter, but disappears entirely when you point `source` at a remote URL. In the first screenshot (source: true) you can see the “</> Code” toggle button in the upper‐right of the HTML preview pane; selecting it shows or hides the code chunks. In the second screenshot (source: <remote URL>) that button is gone. Key UI elements affected are the code‐tools toggle button (the “</> Code” icon) and the code chunk container in the preview.
